title: Oven Roasted Norwegian Sausage Casserole
description: A hearty, comforting casserole featuring Polish sausage and Norwegian flavors, perfect for a sick day, and made with ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly ingredients to promote balance and well-being.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the sweet potatoes, carrots, onions, and Brussels sprouts with olive oil, salt, black pepper, turmeric, and ginger until they are evenly coated.
Spread the vegetables in a single layer on a large baking sheet and roast for 30 minutes.
While the vegetables are roasting, cook the sliced Polish sausage in a large skillet over medium-high heat until browned, about 5 minutes.
After the vegetables have roasted for 30 minutes, add the cooked sausage to the baking sheet and stir to combine.
Return the baking sheet to the oven and continue to roast for an additional 20 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender and the sausage is crispy.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
